name: @neuropause/customer-deployment
description: NeuroPause Enterprise Management System — Production Execution Program, Sprint 5: Enterprise Customer Deployment & Pilot Operations. An additive package that composes Waves 1-14 and Sprints 1-4, unchanged, into a reusable enterprise customer-deployment platform: a customer/tenant/deployment/environment registry with a governed deployment lifecycle; customer onboarding (org/tenant/domain/branding/localization/default policies, roles, AI config); enterprise configuration (business/industry modules, AI workers, workspace, identity providers, security, storage, email, notifications, feature flags); identity federation (Entra ID/Google/Okta/LDAP/AD/OIDC/SAML with user/group/role sync, reusing the Sprint-2 identity platform); customer integration activation (ERP/CRM/HR/finance/manufacturing/healthcare/collaboration/storage/messaging — active only with customer credentials AND verification); a data-migration platform (planning/validation/schema-mapping/dry-run/rollback-planning/reports/verification — never fabricating migrated data); user provisioning (employees/admins/managers/executives/AI workers with invitations, role assignment, permission + license verification); workspace activation; AI workforce activation (only licensed workers); operational acceptance testing (reusing the Sprint-4 end-to-end validation); UAT (plans/cases/scenarios/issues/sign-off — never fabricating approval); customer monitoring (live metrics only when available); a hypercare platform (issue/incident/escalation/SLA, reusing operations incidents); a customer-success platform (adoption/health/renewal/expansion — never fabricating behavior); deployment governance on the one chain; operations runbooks; a configurable pilot profile (Relife Ortho as data, never hard-coded); rollback & recovery (reusing the Sprint-4 recovery validation); and an evidence-based production-readiness Go/No-Go gate (reusing the Sprint-4 readiness scoring + release-candidate gate). Customer-deployment/tenant/monitoring/hypercare runtimes, governance, and documentation are LIVE-VERIFIED; identity providers and ERP/CRM/HR/finance/manufacturing/healthcare/collaboration systems are ADAPTER-VERIFIED until configured and verified; customer production users/transactions/AI-usage/adoption/KPIs are BUSINESS-DATA-PENDING; and customer production infrastructure/networking/VPNs/certificates/databases are INFRASTRUCTURE-PENDING. No proprietary customer data is imported, no UAT approval or sign-off is fabricated, and no General Availability is declared.
